content:
The tallest building in the world is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It stands at 828 meters (2,717 feet) tall and has 163 floors above ground. The building was completed in 2010 and has held the record for tallest building since then.

However, there are several other extremely tall buildings under construction that may surpass it in the future, including the Jeddah Tower in Saudi Arabia, which is planned to exceed 1,000 meters in height.
